scientific_integrity: Exact bijective proof with independent finite graph-level consistency tests. Known initial hub counts and prior wheel lower bounds are credited; no independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats labeled wheel graphs only and does not classify minimal forts up to dihedral symmetry or general cone/cactus families. Full-text access to the 2025 published version of the closest 2024 source was not obtained; independent originality certification remains outstanding.
title: Complete minimal-fort polynomials of wheel graphs and a rational generating function for the central-vertex sequence
